info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Microentry Verification API
info.description: The Microentry Verification API facilitates the validation of microentry records within the system. This endpoint allows users to authenticate and confirm the integrity of submitted data through its verification process. Typical consumers of this API include data management systems and applications that require reliable data submission confirmations. By implementing this API, businesses can enhance their data accuracy and reduce the risk of processing invalid entries, ensuring seamless operations across their platforms.

post.description: This endpoint handles the verification of a microentry generation request, ensuring that the provided data is valid and meets the necessary criteria before processing. It returns the status of the verification along with any relevant details.
